= Ordered and unordered description lists

== Ordered style

.Ordered terms
[#ordered-terms.ignored-role]
[ordered]
First term:: First definition.
Question?:: The punctuation is not duplicated.
Third term:: The answer has *strong* and `code` text.

See <<ordered-terms>>.

== Unordered style

[unordered]
Alpha:: Value A.
Beta:: Value B.

== Stacked answer

[ordered.stack]
Stacked term:: The answer starts on the next line.
Second stacked term:: Another answer.

== Stacked custom subject stop

[ordered.stack,subject-stop=";"]
Explicit stop:: The answer is stacked after a semicolon.

== Custom subject stop

[unordered,subject-stop=";"]
Custom stop:: The term ends with a semicolon.
Already punctuated!:: The existing punctuation remains.

== Ignored alignment role

[unordered.text-center]
Left aligned:: The ordinary role does not change list alignment.

== Shared terms

[ordered]
Short name::
Long name:: Both terms share this answer.

== Attached content

[unordered]
Steps:: Start here.
* First supporting point
* Second supporting point

More detail::
+
--
An attached paragraph.

[ordered]
Nested term:: Nested answer.
--

== Ignored numbering controls

[ordered,start=4,options=reversed]
One:: Starts at one.
Two:: Continues at two.
